components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action in a card or form.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.53 0.15 252); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.53 0.15 252 / 80%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.53 0.15 252 / 50%); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Secondary actions such as pause and resume.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(1 0 0); color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.53 0.15 252 / 50%); }

components.name: Destructive Button
components.description: Removing a Job; red text on a red tint.
components.css: .ds-btn-destructive { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 6px; background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 10%); color: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-btn-destructive:hover { background: oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 20%); } .ds-btn-destructive:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.577 0.245 27.325 / 20%); }

components.name: Text Input
components.css: .ds-input { height: 32px; width: 240px; padding: 4px 10px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font: 400 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.556 0 0); } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.53 0.15 252); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.53 0.15 252 / 50%); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Every settings group and the Job table live in cards.
components.html:
Downloads

Categories, simultaneous downloads, request rate.
components.css: .ds-card { width: 320px; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8.4px; background: oklch(1 0 0); box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px oklch(0.145 0 0 / 10%); font-family: 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-card-body { margin: 4px 0 0; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Status pill; coloured text on a tint (here: Completed).
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 15.6px; background: oklch(0.52 0.14 150 / 12%); color: oklch(0.52 0.14 150); font: 500 12px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Dark rack in both themes; active item raised with blue text.
components.html: Jobs 2SearchProviders
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; gap: 4px; width: 200px; padding: 12px 8px; background: oklch(0.22 0.012 260); font: 500 14px 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-nav-item { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; height: 36px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 6px; color: oklch(0.8 0.01 260); text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background: oklch(0.29 0.014 260); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); } .ds-nav-active { background: oklch(0.29 0.014 260); color: oklch(0.7 0.13 245); } .ds-count { margin-left: auto; padding: 0 6px; border-radius: 3.6px; background: oklch(0.7 0.13 245); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 12px; } .ds-dot { margin-left: auto; width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: oklch(0.8 0.14 75); }

narrative.overview:
Bohemarr's UI is a control room for a service that otherwise runs unattended: the operator walks in to check what is downloading, fix an account, or push one manual Job, then leaves. State, numbers and actions come first; decoration does not. It is dense and utilitarian: compact controls, tight radii, flat surfaces, and colour that reports state.

It deliberately reads as a neighbour of Sonarr and Radarr: a dark sidebar rack on the left in both themes, one content column beside it, and the *arr family's status language (blue for activity, green for connected or done, amber for attention, red for failure). Built on shadcn/ui (`radix-nova`) and Geist; light and dark follow the system theme.
keyCharacteristics: Dark sidebar navigation in both themes; it becomes a horizontal strip on phones.
Colour reports state; neutrals carry everything else.
One family (Geist), hierarchy by weight and size.
Flat panels separated by hairline rings, not shadows.

rules.name: The Earned Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour encodes state. Blue, green, amber and red each mean one thing everywhere; nothing decorative uses them.

rules.name: The Tint Rule
rules.body: Status badges are coloured text on a 12–20% tint of the same colour, never a solid fill.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Hierarchy comes from weight and size inside Geist; no second typeface.

rules.name: The Flat Panel Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on surfaces; a hairline ring or a tonal fill separates panels.

dos: Do use the shadcn components in `web/src/components/ui/` and their variants (including Badge `success` and `warning`) before writing new styles.
Do define colours as tokens on `:root` and `.dark` in `web/src/index.css`.
Do show state with the status vocabulary and words together, never colour alone.
Do keep both themes working; every token has a light and a dark value.
donts: Don't add drop shadows to panels (The Flat Panel Rule).
Don't add a second typeface (The One Family Rule).
Don't use blue, green, amber or red decoratively (The Earned Colour Rule).
Don't mark the active navigation item with a thick coloured side border; use the raised fill and blue text.
